capabilities: scan all Markdown notes for broken internal file links
report each missing link with source note, target, syntax, and line/column position
open the source note and select the original link for manual editing
paginate and reorder results by source path and position
prevent overlapping scans and discard results when sources change mid-scan
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer. The plugin is read-only: it never modifies notes or creates missing destination files. The README documents a reproducible release build with SHA-256 checksums and local installation steps.
problem: Obsidian does not show which existing internal links in a vault point to files that no longer exist.
summary: Broken-link scanner that scans a vault's Markdown notes for internal file links pointing to missing files.
